example.content:
const projectInfo = await eda.dmt_Project.getCurrentProjectInfo();
const teamUuid = projectInfo.teamUuid;

const folderUuid = await eda.dmt_Folder.createFolder('嘉立创示例_改描述', teamUuid, undefined, '嘉立创示例：旧描述');
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));
const modified = await eda.dmt_Folder.modifyFolderDescription(teamUuid, folderUuid, '嘉立创示例：更新后的描述');

_source.example.text.1: 2. 创建带初始描述的测试文件夹，等 1.5s 让工作区同步
_source.example.text.3: 4. 等 1s 让工作区同步，再回读验证

title: Modify Folder description
remarks.text.0: Modifying the folder description requires interaction with the workspace system. The modification is delayed and takes effect only after a short wait
params.description: Folder description. If it is `undefined`, the existing project description is cleared
